parts.name: shell dome

physics.Basic_description: Large red spherical shell with a smooth, matte finish forming the main protective body of the helmet.
physics.Functional_description: Primary impact protection structure enclosing the head cavity.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the top or side curvature with a parallel jaw gripper, ensuring broad contact to distribute force on the curved surface.
physics.reason: Helmet shells are thin-walled composite structures enclosing air/foam, not solid blocks of plastic.

parts.description: Large red spherical shell with a smooth, matte finish forming the main protective body of the helmet.

parts.name: face rim

physics.Basic_description: Black flexible trim outlining the face opening and chin area, appearing matte and slightly textured.
physics.Functional_description: Provides edge protection, comfort sealing, and structural reinforcement for the face opening.
physics.Grasped_description: Can be gripped along the rim edge, though flexible material may deform under pressure.
physics.reason: Trim pieces are typically solid extruded or molded rubber strips without significant internal voids.

parts.description: Black flexible trim outlining the face opening and chin area, appearing matte and slightly textured.

parts.name: rear occipital panel

physics.Basic_description: Dark grey rectangular panel at the rear base featuring horizontal vent slits and a central ridge.
physics.Functional_description: Houses rear ventilation exhaust and aerodynamic shaping elements.
physics.Grasped_description: Not a primary grasp target; gripping here might obstruct vents or slip due to curvature.
physics.reason: Injection molded plastic panel attached to the shell, thin-walled with air behind it.

parts.name: visor panel

physics.Basic_description: Large magenta curved transparent/tinted shield covering the face opening, smooth and glossy.
physics.Functional_description: Protects eyes and face from wind, debris, and impacts while allowing visibility.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the lower edge or side corner carefully to avoid scratching the optical surface.
physics.reason: Visors are thin sheets of polycarbonate, not solid blocks.

parts.description: Large magenta curved transparent/tinted shield covering the face opening, smooth and glossy.
parts.function: Protects eyes and face from wind, debris, and impacts while allowing visibility.

parts.name: visor trim

physics.Basic_description: Pink flexible strip running along the bottom edge of the visor panel.
physics.Functional_description: Seals the gap between visor and shell to prevent wind noise and dust ingress.
physics.Grasped_description: Can be pinched gently, but highly flexible and may slip.
physics.reason: Rubber seals are solid extruded profiles.

parts.description: Pink flexible strip running along the bottom edge of the visor panel.
parts.function: Seals the gap between visor and shell to prevent wind noise and dust ingress.

parts.name: visor pivot arms

physics.Basic_description: Lime green structural arms connecting the visor panel to the helmet shell pivots.
physics.Functional_description: Mechanical linkage allowing the visor to rotate open and closed.
physics.Grasped_description: Robust enough to grasp for manipulating the visor position.
physics.reason: Structural linkage arms are typically solid injection molded plastic to handle torque.

parts.description: Lime green structural arms connecting the visor panel to the helmet shell pivots.
parts.function: Mechanical linkage allowing the visor to rotate open and closed.

parts.name: visor axle

physics.Basic_description: Teal colored central pin or cap at the pivot point of the visor arm.
physics.Functional_description: Rotational axis for the visor mechanism.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and recessed to grasp effectively.
physics.reason: Axles are solid metal rods.

parts.description: Teal colored central pin or cap at the pivot point of the visor arm.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)
simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained
